note: Coupling reaction: benzenediazonium chloride (ring-N(+)#N with a separate Cl-) + aniline, drawn with the para H written out as 'H-' on the ring to mark the coupling position, over an arrow carrying H+, giving p-Aminoazobenzene (yellow dye) + Cl- + H2O. The azo linkage is drawn as a straight horizontal -N=N- between the two rings, which does not fix the geometry about the N=N bond, so no E/Z is written. H+ is the reagent over the arrow and is placed in the agents field.
